verified_facts.text: Paradisus Cancun is an all-inclusive resort in Cancun's Hotel Zone, one of Mexico's most popular beach destinations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Paradisus Cancún delivers exactly what many travelers seek from an all-inclusive: convenience, variety, and fewer out-of-pocket expenses in one of Mexico's most popular beach destinations

verified_facts.text: The resort is spread across five interconnected glass-topped pyramids inspired by Mayan legend and structural geometry.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spread across five interconnected glass-topped pyramids inspired by Mayan legend and structural geometry

verified_facts.text: The resort opened in 1989 as Gran Melia Cancun and welcomed Spain's royal family two years later.
verified_facts.excerpt: when it opened in 1989 as Gran Meliá Cancún, even welcoming Spain's royal family just two years later

verified_facts.text: Paradisus Cancun reopened in April 2026 following an extensive renovation.
verified_facts.excerpt: Paradisus Cancún, which reopened in April 2026 following an extensive renovation

verified_facts.text: Triangular atriums light an open-air design inspired by local cenotes, with live vines cloaking the hallways from the top floor down.
verified_facts.excerpt: Triangular atriums illuminate an open-air design inspired by local cenotes, in which live vines cloak concentric hallways from the top floor down

verified_facts.text: Every furnished balcony has an unobstructed view of either the Caribbean Sea or Nichupte Lagoon, regardless of room category.
verified_facts.excerpt: every furnished balcony enjoys an unobstructed view of either the Caribbean Sea or Nichupté Lagoon, regardless of category

verified_facts.text: The beds face floor-to-ceiling glass toward the balcony.
verified_facts.excerpt: the beds look straight through floor-to-ceiling glass toward the balcony

verified_facts.text: The guest rooms were redesigned in a palette of white, cream and warm woods, accented by woven macrame wall art.
verified_facts.excerpt: have been completely redesigned in a calming palette of white, cream, and warm woods, accented by woven macramé wall art

verified_facts.text: The resort has four pools and the signature YHI Spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: four lavish pools and the signature YHI Spa

verified_facts.text: YHI Spa is a full-service indoor spa with body and facial treatments made with Mexican honey, local ingredients and essential oils.
verified_facts.excerpt: YHI Spa is a full-service, indoor spa that treats you exceptionally well with body and facial treatments created with Mexican honey, local ingredients and essential oils

verified_facts.text: An Eco Spa with Eastern architecture, bamboo and bonsai trees offers Balinese aromatic massage and traditional Thai massage.
verified_facts.excerpt: An authentic Eco Spa dressed in Eastern architecture, bamboo and bonsai trees transports you across the globe as you enjoy a calming Balinese aromatic massage or traditional Thai massage

verified_facts.text: Guests in Family Concierge and The Reserve, and anyone booking a spa treatment, get one hour of complimentary access to the YHI Spa hydrotherapy circuit.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests staying in Family Concierge and The Reserve—as well as anyone booking a spa treatment—also receive one hour of complimentary access to the YHI Spa's hydrotherapy circuit

verified_facts.text: The Reserve is a setting for adults, with its own pool, restaurant, cafe and dedicated concierge service.
verified_facts.excerpt: an adults-only setting with its own pool, restaurant, café, dedicated concierge service

verified_facts.text: Family Concierge rooms come with luxury amenities for kids and parents.
verified_facts.excerpt: Family Concierge is designed for families to spend time together as the rooms come with luxury amenities for kids and parents alike

verified_facts.text: The resort's new spaces include a new water park.
verified_facts.excerpt: The new spaces in Paradisus Cancun feature a new water park

verified_facts.text: The resort has nine restaurants, seven bars, an artisan gelato shop and a Nespresso cafe.
verified_facts.excerpt: Between nine restaurants, seven bars, an artisan gelato shop, and a Nespresso café

verified_facts.text: A sunset cruise through Nichupte Lagoon is offered exclusively to The Reserve and Family Concierge guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: a sunset cruise through Cancún's Nichupté Lagoon, exclusively for The Reserve and Family Concierge guests

verified_facts.text: An on-property Alebrije workshop teaches the craft behind Mexico's brightly colored folk art with local artisans.
verified_facts.excerpt: the on-property Alebrije workshop more rewarding, spending an afternoon learning the craft behind Mexico's brightly colored folk art from local artisans

verified_facts.text: Activities include sushi workshops, wine tastings, pool parties and yoga classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: including sushi workshops, wine tastings, pool parties and yoga classes

verified_facts.text: The resort has four pickleball courts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Four pickleball courts were consistently available

verified_facts.text: The Play District and the Kanna beach club are not included in the all-inclusive rate.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just know that these attractions aren't included in the all-inclusive rate. Same goes for Kanna, the property's stylish beach club

verified_facts.text: During the warmer months, sargassum seaweed can affect expectations for the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: if you're visiting during the warmer months, keep your expectations in check when it comes to sargassum seaweed

verified_facts.text: One pool has a colorful splash park with small slides, tipping buckets, fountains and a shallow wading area for toddlers.
verified_facts.excerpt: anchored by a colorful splash park with pint-sized slides, tipping buckets, fountains, and a shallow wading area for toddlers

verified_facts.text: Beach conditions are typically more favorable from mid-October to April.
verified_facts.excerpt: consider traveling later in the year when conditions are typically more favorable, typically mid-October to April

verified_facts.text: The resort begins clearing the beach before sunrise each morning.
verified_facts.excerpt: The resort begins clearing the beach before sunrise each morning
